meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 运行后会把旧版记忆文件(如 CLAUDE.md、.seed.md)整理成新的统一记忆结构与常设指令:内容归类、补好索引,让更换程序后旧内容仍可继续使用。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate memory”“legacy memory”等话,或更新提示共享记忆不兼容,或组内仍留有 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等旧记忆文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我把旧的 CLAUDE.md、.seed.md 等记忆迁到共享记忆树。
say.note: 会先列出受影响组和冲突,经你批准后才开始移动。

say.text: 换程序后它忘掉旧事了,请重新迁移并整理记忆。
say.note: 结束时给出每份文件的去向报告供你核对。

say.text: 先给我看迁移方案和整理结果,我批准后再写入。
say.note: 移动、归类与最后撤除暂存都会等确认。

howto.what_en: It reorganizes old memory files (CLAUDE.md, .seed.md) into the unified memory structure and standing instructions, sorts content, adds indexes, and keeps old facts usable after a provider switch.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate memory" or "legacy memory", or when an update reports breaking shared-memory compatibility, or when a group still has .seed.md/CLAUDE.md legacy files.

say_en.text: Move my old CLAUDE.md and .seed.md memories into the shared tree.
say_en.note: Changes start only after your approval.

say_en.text: It forgot old things after switching; please migrate and reorganize its memory.
say_en.note: A source-to-destination report is shown for review.

say_en.text: Show me the plan and collisions first; write only after my approval.
say_en.note: Moving, sorting, and cleanup wait for confirmation.
